Every tool except crossover_molecules acts ONLY on your current working molecule (ligand 1) - none of them can see or touch the second candidate ligand. Treat ligand 2 as inspiration only: if you want to bring in one of its features, either call crossover_molecules to combine the two, or rebuild that feature yourself on your current working molecule (e.g. with add_substructure). An atom index you give to any tool other than crossover_molecules is always interpreted against your current working molecule, never against ligand 2 - do not reason about 'modifying ligand 2' and then call one of these tools, since the edit will land on the wrong molecule and likely do nothing you intended.

Goal: I want to maximize jnk3, qed scores; minimize sa score. Please propose a new molecule better than the current molecule. I have given you two candidate ligands. You are encouraged to make a crossover between the candidate molecules on the first step, then mutate the resulting molecule. Only make a few modifications (at most 3), then respond with FINAL ANSWER. Do not let molecular weight exceed 700.

Ligand 1 is the phenyl molecule: jnk3 0.70, the highest activity in four runs, wasted by QED 0.623. Atom 11 is the azine carbon carrying that phenyl at atom 12 over a non-ring biaryl bond, and atom 22 is the cyclopentane CH on the carbonyl at atom 1. Both problems are lipophilicity, so I will fix both in this episode. Step one replaces the benzene with a 1-methylpyrazol-4-yl: still a flat aromatic in the same position, but a five-membered ring with two nitrogens, worth over two log units and about 18 of polar surface. The fragment has exactly six atoms like the benzene it replaces, so the numbering downstream is unchanged and I can plan the second cut now.

Step two replaces the cyclopentyl cap - the greasiest in my set, and the second reason this molecule sits at LogP 5 - with a cyclopropyl. Atom 1 is the carbonyl and atom 22 the cyclopentane CH; if the numbering has shifted the two will simply not be bonded and the call fails without damage. Between the pyrazole and the lighter cap this should come in around 333 Da at LogP near 3.0 with QED in the mid 0.8s, and cap ring size has measured activity-neutral five times now, so the 0.70 should survive if the pyrazole holds it.
